item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod kyi nyams len gnad kyi man ngag
rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod kyi nyams len gnad kyis man ngag
item.coloph: khyab bdal rdzogs pa chen po'i don/ bder gshegs dgongs rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' snang mdog thugs kyi bcud/ gyer spungs nga nyid 'di yis grol/ stang chen thugs kyis (kyi) dkyil du zhogs(zhog)phyi rab (rabs) las ldan skyes bu ni/ ge sar mkhan pos byin gyis brlabs/ shes rab bde ldan snying po rtsal/ man ngag 'di yis (yi) snod du rung / gcig rgyud dag du gdab par mdzod/ mang na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad bkyon/ nyung na man ngag rtsa 'gag 'gro/ de phyir gtang bzhag tshad 'dzin gces/ u ya swa ti 'gu yA smar//

item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod kyi nyams len gnad kyi man ngag
